title: Westbound transatlantic capacity settles after a volatile Q1
content:
The normally staid transatlantic trade has recently experienced a tumultuous period of uncharacteristically volatile pricing, by its standards at least, largely as result of capacity injections and subsequent removals.
Throughput last year, and up to the outbreak of the US/Israel-Iran conflict, volumes have been flat, tempered by tariffs, while rates continually weakened.
Meanwhile, the Container Trades Statistics Price Index has been in steady decline since the beginning of 2025.
